knowledge:
- key_parameters: tracks=A single BigWig file, a named list of BigWig files, a BigWigFile, or a BigWigFileList ;; features=A GRanges or a named GRangesList object representing genomic regions of interest ;; width=Numeric value used to center features to their midpoint and resize them to the chosen width ;; window=An integer specifying the bin size to average coverage scores over non-overlapping bins during CoverageExperiment creation or coarsening ;; bin=An integer specifying the bin size used during aggregation ;; scale=Logical indicating whether to scale the coverage scores ;; center=Logical indicating whether to center features around their midpoint
- alternatives: Traditional SummarizedExperiment objects store atomic values in individual cells, whereas CoverageExperiment stores a list containing a matrix of per-base coverage scores in each cell. tidySummarizedExperiment can be loaded to enable direct dplyr verb manipulation on CoverageExperiment and AggregatedCoverage objects without explicit coercion.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you need to compare and visualize linear coverage profiles (e.g., ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq) across multiple genomic tracks over a single locus or aggregated across thousands of genomic features.
- pitfalls: Coarsening a CoverageExperiment with a window size and then aggregating is NOT mathematically equivalent to aggregating a per-base CoverageExperiment with a bin size, because certain statistical operations (such as standard deviation, min, and max) are not commutative with the mean.

workflows.name: single_locus_coverage
workflows.intent: Extract and plot coverage of multiple tracks over a single genomic locus.
workflows.stages: 1. Load genomic tracks as a BigWigFileList ;; 2. Define the genomic locus of interest as a GRanges object ;; 3. Instantiate a CoverageExperiment object ;; 4. Coarsen the coverage resolution using coarsen() ;; 5. Expand the object into a tidy tibble using expand() ;; 6. Plot the coverage tracks using ggplot2 and geom_coverage()
workflows.code:
tracks <- list(
    Scc1 = system.file("extdata", "Scc1.bw", package = "tidyCoverage"), 
    RNA_fwd = system.file("extdata", "RNA.fwd.bw", package = "tidyCoverage"),
    RNA_rev = system.file("extdata", "RNA.rev.bw", package = "tidyCoverage"),
    PolII = system.file("extdata", "PolII.bw", package = "tidyCoverage"), 
    MNase = system.file("extdata", "MNase.bw", package = "tidyCoverage")
) |> BigWigFileList()

locus <- GRanges("II:450001-475000")

CE_chrII <- CoverageExperiment(
    tracks = tracks, 
    features = locus,
    width = width(locus)
)

library(ggplot2)
CE_chrII |> 
    coarsen(window = 10) |> 
    expand() |> 
    ggplot() + 
    geom_coverage(aes(fill = track)) + 
    facet_grid(track~., scales = 'free')

workflows.name: aggregated_coverage_multiple_features
workflows.intent: Extract, aggregate, and plot coverage of multiple tracks over multiple sets of genomic features.
workflows.stages: 1. Import genomic features and filter by strand ;; 2. Import genomic tracks as Rle objects ;; 3. Create a CoverageExperiment object with scaling and centering enabled ;; 4. Aggregate the coverage across features using aggregate() ;; 5. Coerce the AggregatedCoverage object to a tibble using as_tibble() ;; 6. Plot the aggregated coverage profiles using ggplot2 and geom_aggrcoverage()
workflows.code:
library(purrr)
library(plyranges)

features <- list(
    TSSs = system.file("extdata", "TSSs.bed", package = "tidyCoverage"),
    `Convergent transcription` = system.file("extdata", "conv_transcription_loci.bed", package = "tidyCoverage")
) |> map(import) |> map(filter, strand == '+') 

tracks <- list(
    Scc1 = system.file("extdata", "Scc1.bw", package = "tidyCoverage"), 
    RNA_fwd = system.file("extdata", "RNA.fwd.bw", package = "tidyCoverage"),
    RNA_rev = system.file("extdata", "RNA.rev.bw", package = "tidyCoverage"),
    PolII = system.file("extdata", "PolII.bw", package = "tidyCoverage"), 
    MNase = system.file("extdata", "MNase.bw", package = "tidyCoverage")
) |> map(import, as = 'Rle')

CE <- CoverageExperiment(tracks, features, width = 5000, scale = TRUE, center = TRUE)

AC <- aggregate(CE)

AC |> 
    as_tibble() |> 
    ggplot(aes(col = track, linetype = track %in% c('RNA_fwd', 'RNA_rev'))) + 
    geom_aggrcoverage() + 
    facet_grid(features ~ .) + 
    labs(x = 'Distance from genomic feature', y = 'Mean coverage (Â± 95% conf. intervale)') + 
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(legend.position = 'top')
